locations.note: Laser-scanned modern GP layout, plus three historic 1966 layouts, including the full course over the banked Sopraelevata, added in the 1.8 update.
One of four tracks in the 2013 Early Access launch, later reworked in the 1.5 update along with the game's other oldest circuits.
The only track in the February 2013 Technology Preview, a free benchmark that let players try the physics engine in a Lotus Elise SC.
The first new track after launch, added in Early Access update 0.2 in November 2013 alongside a fictional drift circuit.
Offers the GP and Sprint layouts, each also in a GT variant, two of them added in the 1.5 update; the Nordschleife is a separate Dream Pack 1 track.
In the game since the 2013 Early Access launch, now with GP, International and National layouts plus a historic 1967 version.
Kunos had its R&D office at this circuit; the game offers Normal, Club and Classic layouts, the Classic one added in the 1.5 update.
Recreated in 2014 as the game's only hillclimb: the 17.3 km climb from Trento to Vason used by the European Hill Climb Championship.
Added free in the 1.2 update in July 2015, and the one modern circuit Kunos chose not to laser-scan, as an experiment.
